children: According to Wallstreetcn, Oracle's protective measures to guard against possible delays in a large data center project in New Mexico have chilled the trillion-dollar AI infrastructure financing market, and Oracle has issued a force majeure notice for its "Project Jupiter." Blue Owl said the notice did not change the parties' commitment to the project, but the move has still reverberated through other planned data center financing talks, including SB Energy's development of a data center campus for OpenAI in Ohio, where a person close to its financing said SB Energy decided this week to delay its IPO.

title: AI Infrastructure Financing Market Cools After Oracle Issues Force Majeure Notice
